messages:
ivy: Quick meeting note - propose we standardize "lanes" + a billing template for long-running pins so CS has predictable offers. Want to avoid ad-hoc exceptions.

noah: Agreed. Suggest lanes: fast (30d free), standard (90d discounted), extended (180d paid). Each lane maps to TTL, support level, and surcharge.

kai: Infra constraints: per-account pin limit = 2, global_soft_cap = 120, default_ttl_days = 90. If soft_cap reached, new requests hit waitlist and CS gets notified.

em: ML/Quality: require a small benchmark bundle for lane enrollment: 200 seed prompts semantic check, embedding drift <= 0.025 mean cosine, p95 latency delta <= 12%. Failure = only temporary 14d pin.

ivy: Billing template idea: include fields emitted on enrollment: account_id, model, lane, ttl_days, reserved_memory_gb, surcharge_rate. Example CSV row: 
`acct123, redwood-v2, standard, 90, 1.2, 25.00`

billing-bot: INFO: will accept ledger events with keys: account_id, event_ts, model, lane, ttl_days, reserved_gb, surcharge_usd.

noah: UI: request modal collects reason checkbox (compliance, regression, contract), lane selector, requested_ttl, attach bench link. Auto-generate addendum when lane=extended.

kai: Emergency path: emergency_pin(14d) requires 3-owner approval (product+infra+legal) and incident tag. Also emit audit log entry.

em: Monitoring: sample 1% of bridged traffic daily for regression report; alert if regression >2% over 24h. Canary rollout on cutover: 5% traffic for 24h.

ivy: Negotiation playbook (CS): offer migration credit (2 weeks), one migration workshop, and a one-click fallback. For >180d require contract amendment and pass-through cost.

noah: Action items: Kai spec infra hooks + billing events (3d), Em publish bench bundle + monitor spec (3d), Ivy draft addendum + CS script (2d). I'll file RW-PL-7810.

billing-bot: Created ticket RW-PL-7810 and assigned to @noah.
